item.title: Peacock Raises Subscription Prices Across All Plans
item.description: Peacock hikes its ad‑supported, ad‑tier, and ad‑free plans by $1‑$3 effective Aug 18, impacting new and existing users and reflecting broader streaming price pressures industry‑wide.
